title: Edition
description: Several checked stories on one page, grouped into sections. Paths are relative to this file.

title.description: The edition's name, at the top of the page and in the browser tab.

dek.description: Optional: one sentence under the title.

date.description: Optional: the edition's date, written as readers should see it.

footer.description: Optional: a closing line at the end of the page.

sections.description: In reading order. The page opens with a link to each.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The section's link target, as in page.html#travel.

icon.description: Optional: an emoji shown before the title.
